text:
karen_sales: POC with BetaCorp: sending full chat history (~150-200k tokens) -> intermittent 413 from their gateway. Short chats succeed. Need quick help and a one-paragraph note for their infra team.
noah_se: Sounds classic gateway body-limit. Ask them to check nginx client_max_body_size and any LB/WAF limits. Also confirm whether client uses Transfer-Encoding: chunked or sets Content-Length incorrectly.
cust_infra_bot: infra logs: "upstream prematurely closed connection" and "client intended to send too large body"
rachel_eng: Quick paste-for-ops we can send:
"Your edge is rejecting large POSTs before they reach us. Please increase client_max_body_size (eg. 20M) and verify your load balancer/WAF max request size and chunked transfer behavior. If policy forbids increasing ingress, use a retrieval/summarization pattern (store long history server-side and send only relevant chunks) or a streaming approach your gateway supports."
noah_se: Cost note for 200k-token contexts at ~50/day: rough monthly billed tokens ~ (200k * 50 * 30)=300M input tokens plus outputs; multiply by hosted per-token rate. Dedicated can lower unit cost but depends on commit. Recommend RAG to cut to ~5-10k tokens per request.
karen_sales: I will forward the note and request a redacted sample payload for token sanity-check. Thanks. :thumbsup:
